records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue decreased by $67.7 million, or 21.5%, during the three months ended April 1, 2023 compared to the same period a year ago.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Additionally, we have seen demand for our NE and SE products affected by macroeconomic uncertainty.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Product revenues decreased by $70.6 million, or 25.6%, during the three months ended April 1, 2023 compared to the same period a year ago, driven by revenue decreases in all segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Through lingering economic turbulence, there continue to be periodic shipping and logistics challenges and continued supply chain constraints, shortages and delays, along with inflationary pricing pressures.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the nine months ended April 1, 2023, Cash provided by operating activities was $90.6 million, consisting of net income of $25.6 million adjusted for non-cash charges (e.g., depreciation, amortization, stock-based compensation and other non-cash items) which totaled $106.6 million, including changes in deferred tax balances, and changes in operating assets and liabilities that used $41.6 million.
